🚀 claude-code-karma | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a user-friendly, visual interface for monitoring and analyzing their Claude Code sessions locally, offering insights into session activity, tool usage, and agent interactions.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first dashboard for Claude Code sessions • Visualizes sessions, timelines, costs, and live activity • Reads directly from `~/.claude/` data • Session Browser with search and filtering
📖 Summary: Claude Code Karma is a local-first, open-source dashboard designed to visualize and monitor Claude Code sessions. It transforms raw session data from `~/.claude/` into an interactive timeline, session browser, and detailed overviews of tasks, files, subagents, and skills invoked during a session.
